pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, roughly polygonal dark regions with soft, blurred edge gradients rather than sharp transitions. Patches are largest and most contiguous on the shoulder and upper flank, becoming significantly smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous graph of off-white negative space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the primary flank area, maintaining high connectivity without significant narrowing.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a consistent, low-amplitude serration. The 1D silhouette against the background exhibits a high-frequency, jagged geometric profile.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical skin fold or anatomical crease is visible extending from the mid-dorsal region down toward the ventral flank.
